WITH scope_counts AS (
  SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY u.acctscope
)
SELECT acctscope,
       record_count,
       1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total,
       1.0 * record_count / AVG(record_count) OVER () AS relative_to_average
FROM scope_counts;
